scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run check:api && npm run check:frontend
scripts.generate:api: npm run export:api-schema && openapi-typescript openapi.json --default-non-nullable false -o frontend/src/lib/api.generated.ts && node scripts/generate-api-constraints.mjs
scripts.check:api: openapi-typescript openapi.json --default-non-nullable false --check -o frontend/src/lib/api.generated.ts && node scripts/generate-api-constraints.mjs --check
scripts.check:frontend: npm --workspace frontend run test && npm --workspace frontend run lint && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
